title: How Apple Really Makes Money (It's Not Just the iPhone)
alts: Apple's Secret Profit Machine Isn't the iPhone
Why Google Pays Apple $20 Billion a Year
line1: How does Apple really make money? The iPhone is half of $416B in sales, but services keep 75 cents of every dollar. Here's the walled garden.
summary: Dave upgrades his phone and gets pulled into Apple's walled garden. Using Apple's latest 10-K we break down revenue by product, why services have double the margin of hardware, the App Store's 30%/15% commission, Google's roughly $20 billion default-search payments and the antitrust ruling, iCloud, Music and TV subscriptions, blue bubbles and 2.5 billion active devices, with both sides of the lock-in debate.
